questions.q: For the model $f(x) = 2x + 3$ in solving trigonometric equations 2, evaluate $f(2)$.
Find the positive solutions to the quadratic equation $x^2 - 7x + 6 = 0$.
A data set recorded for solving trigonometric equations 2 consists of the four values $\{18, 22, 26, 32\}$. What is the arithmetic mean?
questions.answer: The sum is $18 + 22 + 26 + 32 = 98$, and dividing by $4$ gives $24.5$.
